name: vent-feasibility-gate
title: Vent carbon-fixation feasibility gate (eQuilibrator ΔG')
question: Driven as a process-bigraph Step, does eQuilibrator report H2-driven reductive CO2 fixation to formate, acetate and pyruvate as thermodynamically feasible at alkaline-hydrothermal-vent conditions?
hypothesis: At pH 9.5, 333.15 K, with dissolved H2 (5 mM) and CO2 (2 mM), eQuilibrator's transformed Gibbs free energies ΔG' for the three reductive CO2-fixation reactions are all negative (exergonic), opening the feasibility gate.
objective: Demonstrate end to end that viva_equilibrator.composites.feasibility.equilibrator_feasibility_gate runs the real eQuilibrator engine and emits per-reaction ΔG' and feasibility, with eQuilibrator acting as a pluggable process-bigraph thermodynamics Step.
description: The basic-functionality showcase for viva-equilibrator. A fixed vent condition in a `world` store feeds EquilibratorThermoStep, which calls component-contribution to compute ΔG' for three reductive CO2-fixation reactions and a per-reaction feasibility flag. The composite is Step-only (no time-advancing process), so it emits one row. Observed: ΔG'(formate) = -48.66, ΔG'(acetate) = -150.74, ΔG'(pyruvate) = -88.28 kJ/mol; feasibility >= 0.9999 for all three.

expected_behavior.name: thermodynamic-feasibility
expected_behavior.en: Every reductive CO2-fixation reaction is exergonic at the vent condition — the largest ΔG' across the three reactions is still negative.
expected_behavior.rationale: An H2-rich alkaline vent provides a strong reducing drive; reductive CO2 fixation to these products should run downhill (ΔG' < 0).

expected_behavior.name: feasibility-gate-open
expected_behavior.en: The per-reaction feasibility flags all report the gate open (feasibility ~1).
expected_behavior.rationale: The feasibility flag is a smooth gate on ΔG'; strongly exergonic reactions map to feasibility ~1.0.

behavior_tests.name: thermodynamic-feasibility
behavior_tests.description: max(ΔG'_formate, ΔG'_acetate, ΔG'_pyruvate) < 0 (observed max = -48.66 kJ/mol; all three exergonic).

behavior_tests.name: feasibility-gate-open
behavior_tests.description: min feasibility across the three reactions >= 0.99 (observed min = 0.99999998).

findings.name: exergonic-carbon-fixation
findings.statement: At vent conditions eQuilibrator reports ΔG'(formate) = -48.66, ΔG'(acetate) = -150.74, ΔG'(pyruvate) = -88.28 kJ/mol, all exergonic, with feasibility >= 0.9999 — the full reductive CO2-fixation gate is open.
findings.provenance: Observed in an isolated-venv run of the feasibility-gate composite on viva-equilibrator 0.1.0 / equilibrator-api 0.8.1, 2026-11-27, fully offline (reproduced by sims/run.py).

conclusion: PASS on both acceptance bands. Run as a process-bigraph Step, eQuilibrator found all three H2-driven reductive CO2-fixation reactions strongly exergonic at vent conditions (max ΔG' = -48.66 kJ/mol) with feasibility ~1.0. eQuilibrator behaves as a drop-in process-bigraph thermodynamics engine, computed entirely offline.

derived.insight: At vent conditions eQuilibrator reports ΔG'(formate) = -48.66, ΔG'(acetate) = -150.74, ΔG'(pyruvate) = -88.28 kJ/mol, all exergonic, with feasibility >= 0.9999 — the full reductive CO2-fixation gate is open.
